forecast.generalSituationZh: 一股達強風程度的東北季候風會在週末期間影響廣東沿岸。預料一道冷鋒會在星期一初時橫過華南沿岸，受相關的強烈東北季候風影響，該區北風增強，氣溫顯著下降，下週中期廣東普遍晴朗及乾燥，內陸地區早上清涼，日夜溫差較大。預料高空擾動會在下週後期為華南帶來有雨的天氣。
forecast.generalSituationEn: A strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China at first on Monday. Under the influence of the associated intense northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen from the north and temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. The weather will be generally fine and dry over Guangdong midweek next week. It will be cool in the morning over inland areas, and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring rainy weather to southern China in the latter part of next week.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早晚有一兩陣雨。日間部分時間天色明朗。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning and at night. Bright periods during the day.
days.windZh: 東風5級，離岸及高地間中達7級。
days.windEn: East force 5, occasionally up to force 7 offshore and on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早晚有一兩陣微雨。日間部分時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Sunny periods during the day.
days.windZh: 東至東北風5級，初時離岸間中6級，高地達7級。
days.windEn: East to northeast force 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first, up to force 7 on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 早上天氣較涼及有一兩陣雨。日間漸轉天晴乾燥。晚上氣溫進一步下降。
days.weatherEn: Cooler with one or two rain patches in the morning. Becoming fine and dry during the day. Temperatures will fall further at night.
days.windZh: 北風5級，離岸間中6級，高地達8級。
days.windEn: North force 5, occasionally force 6 offshore, up to force 8 on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 早上顯著較涼。大致天晴。日間非常乾燥。
days.weatherEn: Appreciably cooler in the morning. Mainly fine. Very dry during the day.
days.windZh: 北至東北風4至5級，初時離岸及高地間中6級。
days.windEn: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
